page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. No left margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: & ecclesiam Dei pene deficere, pro ea, quâ
erant fidei infirmitate, putare: solatur Deus
fideles, eo quod ipsorum semen ramos exten-
surum per progressus aquarum, gentium vo-
catione esset. Ita Isai. 54. 1, 2, 3. &c. Gal.
4. 27. Esai. 2. v. 1, 2, 3. dixerim vix le-
gisse scripturas qui assereret non esse vocatio-
nem gentium, judæis solatio. 5. Resp. Re-
mon. lib. Promissio ad totum populum dirigitur:

l.i: at gratia ista peculiaris non ad totum populum perti-
net: denique si ad paucos tantum quosdam, ex gen-
tibus nominatum à Deo ab æterno electos promissio
pertinere dicatur, quænam erat solatio hæc qua Israe-

main_text.l: lem Deus vult erigere contra metum &c. R. 1.
Communi hac cantilenâ nihil frigidius: an ex
Dei intentione & decreto promissiones evan-
gelicæ ad reprobos spectent, vos dicite, id
nos negamus.
2. Solamen non mediocre est
electis promissio gratiæ determinantis: repro-
bis nihil in scripturis solatio esse dicimus: quid
illis cum pace, cum solatio, cum spiritus
sancti gaudio?
3. Dicite ex conscientiis ecquid
solatii sit ullis filiis Adami, ex promissione illius
gratiæ, adversus omnes hujus vitæ, mundi,
peccati, Diaboli, ærumnarum omnium, mor-
tis, & infernalis terroris, insultus & tentati-
ones, quâ posita fieri potest ut omnes in æter-
num exitium ruant, & illis omnes tentationes
cedant in extremum malum, liquidem ipsi,
uti liberè possent, voluntatem flectant ad as-
sentiendum tentationi. Certe hic in libero
arbitrio sive in nova Dea contingentiâ aut for-
tunâ,

page.notes: Page number read as "415"; the final digit is a worn form and is marked [?]. The printed "ff" is transcribed as "ss" (Promissio, Dissertatio-style spelling) and long s as plain s. The marginal "s. Resp." and "Remonst." are small italic notes; I read them as shown. Italic passages are marked with <i>; the reference "Isai." is italic in print. The line "tunâ," is the completion of the hyphenated word "for-tunâ," and is kept in the text, not as a catchword.
